text: The purpose of this report is to present the Board with an opportunity for TO Live to expand its services across the sector.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Authorized TO Live to explore the opportunity to expand its services across the sector, as more particularly detailed in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 6, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 6, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer remain confidential in its entirety, as it is about a plan to be applied to any negotiations carried on or to be carried on by or on behalf of TO Live.
